privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what data jichcha receives, why, and when it is deleted. Data is processed under the Law of the Republic of Uzbekistan “On Personal Data”.

p: Files are used only for the task you choose. We don't read, sell or share their contents.

The original is deleted as soon as processing ends. Results are deleted automatically after 1 hour for guests and 6 hours for account holders, or right away with “Delete from server now”. Files are never backed up.
Every file is scanned for viruses before processing. GPS and camera details from phone photos are not copied into results.
For an account we keep your email, a one-way hash of your password (Argon2) and your interface language. With Google sign-in, Google only tells us your verified email.
History keeps the tool name, file names, sizes and times for 30 days. The files themselves are deleted on the schedule above.
“Delete account permanently” on the account page removes your account, history and files immediately.
jichcha_guest: shows your results in this browser when you're not signed in. It holds a random token; the server stores only its hash.
jichcha_refresh: keeps you signed in for 7 days.
Browser storage (localStorage) keeps only your theme choice (light or dark).
No advertising, tracking or analytics cookies are used.
Your IP address is used for anti-abuse limits and held in memory for a few minutes. Server logs are kept for a limited time for security and troubleshooting.
Google: only if you press “Continue with Google”.
Error reporting: application errors are sent without personal data (no cookies, IP addresses or file contents).
You can ask to see, correct or delete data about you. You can delete your account and files yourself on the site. For anything else, write to the address below.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By using jichcha you agree to these terms.

p: jichcha is a free service for converting, compressing and editing files. Daily limits and size caps protect it from abuse and may change.
Upload only files you have the right to use. You are responsible for their contents and for how you use the results.
A password-protected file can be opened only with its password, which is used for that file alone and never stored.
Uploading malware, getting around limits, automated bulk use, attacking or disrupting the service, or spreading illegal content. If this happens, files are deleted and the account may be blocked.
The service is provided “as is”. We can't guarantee every file converts perfectly, so keep your original. Download results before they expire: there are no backups of files.
Keep your password secret. Accounts that break these terms may be removed or blocked. You can delete your account at any time.
These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Uzbekistan. If they change, the new version is published on this page with its date.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Answers about jichcha: what it costs, file limits, how long files are kept, supported formats and the Telegram bot.
faq.intro: Short answers to what people ask most. Didn't find yours? Write to us using the contact at the bottom of the privacy policy.

items.a: Yes. Every tool is free, with no watermarks and no trial period. An account is free too: it only raises the limits.

No. Without an account you can upload files up to {{guestMb}} MB, run {{guestTasks}} tasks a day and process up to {{guestBatch}} files at once. A free account raises this to {{userMb}} MB, {{userTasks}} tasks a day and {{userBatch}} files, and keeps a 30-day history of your tasks.

They are used only to do the conversion you asked for. Every upload is checked for viruses, and files are deleted automatically: after {{guestHours}} hour without an account, after {{userHours}} hours with one. You can also delete a result yourself right away.

PDF: merge, split, reorder pages, compress, unlock, turn pages into JPG or PNG. Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, RTF and CSV to PDF. Photos: JPG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF, HEIC, GIF, BMP and TIFF — convert, compress, crop, rotate, resize, or combine into one PDF. Archives: open ZIP, RAR, 7Z, TAR, GZ, BZ2 and XZ, create ZIP or 7Z, or repack one archive type as another.

items.q: Why does my Word file look slightly different as a PDF?
items.a: Documents are converted with LibreOffice. If the document uses a font we don't have, a similar one is used and lines can shift a little. Common fonts such as Arial, Times New Roman or Calibri convert most faithfully; you can also embed fonts when saving in Word.

items.q: Can I open a password-protected PDF or archive?
items.a: Yes, if you know the password. The “Unlock PDF” tool and archive extraction ask for it. The password is used only for that one task and is never stored.

We check what a file really is, not just its extension, so a renamed file of another type is refused. Other reasons: the file is larger than your limit, the daily limit is used up, the file is damaged or encrypted, or the virus check found something. The message on screen names the exact reason.

Yes. Send a file to the bot and pick what to do with it from the buttons; send several photos as an album to get one PDF. Telegram lets bots download files up to 20 MB, so for bigger files the bot gives you a link to the website.

items.q: How do I keep my account safe?
items.a: Use a password you don't use anywhere else, and turn on two-step sign-in in the Security section of your account. After that, every sign-in also asks for a code from an app such as Google Authenticator or Authy.

items.q: How do I delete my account?
items.a: Open your account page and choose “Delete account”. Your account, history and all stored files are deleted at once and can't be restored.
